iOS · Wisconsin Creative

Native reservation availability copy and Review

Gear now names the person on a hold in reservation purple or checkout red. Review is a grouped form with a matchup-only title, and it no longer calls timing notices conflicts.

After-only fixture evidence

iPhone 16 Pro (27.0) UDID E055DEBC-12B1-4E0F-BE11-1CFFF4A454DE, WisconsinPerformance create-booking-events, light appearance. The 7:43 AM device screenshots are live inventory in a different clock and appearance, so they are not a matched before pair.

What changed, and why

Hold copy

Was

Conflict rows named the overlapping booking and window. Needed-next used clock-advisory language, often read as a conflict.

Now

Reserved holds name the person and start in purple. Active checkouts name the person and until-time in red.

Cart and quantities

Was

The selected cart could inherit a red tint. Battery and counted rows used custom plus/minus circles.

Now

The cart icon is reservation purple with a system red badge. Counted quantities use a system Stepper.

Review

Was

The title kept promotion extras after the matchup. Schedule used colored icon circles. A conflict card counted every visible catalog hold, including items that were not selected.

Now

Review is a grouped form. The title is matchup-only. Schedule uses LabeledContent. A route back to Gear appears only when a selected item is actually blocked.
